answer: Streak multiplier: each validator's weight = base × (consecutive epochs attested)^1.5, reset to 1 on any miss. The prism splits honest long-run streaks from fresh sybil clusters, since a farm must sustain 30+ epochs of perfect uptime before weight pays off. A tide of new identities earns near-zero influence until streaks mature, and a comet validator appearing for one epoch captures 1/900th the reward of a 30-epoch node. Attack cost: 900 identities × 30 epochs of gas exceeds any single-epoch payout. Works because sybils are penalized by time, not capital alone.
